What if most of the facts holding you back are just opinions?

Kevin Trudeau says that when your attitude is right, what you think are facts today stop counting. Most of them were someone's opinion anyway.

The few that are real get replaced by new facts you cannot see yet, because they are off your radar screen.

His point is that the obstacles you are staring at can fall away once your attitude changes.

Which fact are you treating as untouchable?
